initialExam.title: AFCAT (Air Force Common Admission Test) 2026
initialExam.description: Air Force Common Admission Test for Flying Branch, Technical Branch, and Ground Duty Branch officer entry in IAF.
initialExam.qualifications: B.E./B.Tech for Technical, Graduation for Ground Duty
initialExam.syllabus: General Awareness, Verbal Ability in English, Numerical Ability, Reasoning & Military Aptitude Test. EKT for Technical Branch: Mechanical, Computer Science, Electrical & Electronics.
initialExam.examPattern: AFCAT: 100 questions, 300 marks, 2 hours. EKT (Tech Branch): 50 questions, 150 marks, 45 min. AFSB Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: AFCAT → AFSB Interview (5 days) → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Flying Officer in Flying, Technical, and Ground Duty branches of IAF
initialExam.careerGrowth: Flying Officer → Flight Lieutenant → Squadron Leader → Wing Commander → Group Captain → Air Commodore.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit afcat.cdac.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Submit (AFCAT II 2026)
initialExam.perks: Flying Allowance, Accommodation, CSD, Medical, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: Flying: max 24 years, Tech/GD: max 26 years
